mode: Built-in image_gen edits of approved map and podium assets

maps.common: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied vertical 750x1280 game map as an approved existing illustration, not a new visual direction. Preserve the exact camera, sunny polished TWO-DIMENSIONAL rural game illustration style, light outlines, softly shaded forms, vivid palette, and especially the full cream S-shaped path with its dashed center line and every bend in the same coordinates. Preserve its portrait aspect ratio and edge-to-edge ground. Client wants thematic variety beyond repeated flowers and grass. Replace a majority of decorative flower clumps near the OUTER SIDE EDGES with three or four small recognisable theme-specific landmarks, distributed between upper/middle/lower portions so they are visible when scrolling. Keep the whole central path and adjacent wide open areas clear for UI overlays. Crucial clear UI zones (in 750x1280 reference coordinates) around (500,1088),(225,819),(500,537),(195,307): do not paint buildings, figures, signs or details onto these positions or their nearby writing areas. Most new details should sit in the narrow outer strips x<115 or x>640, with secondary accents close to an existing edge building. Do not add any UI, circles, podiums, buttons, numbers, text, lettering, mascot, human figures, title banner, frames or panels. Do not change the path shape, don't create a second path. Avoid realistic architecture, antique ink paintings, 3D render toys, busy confetti, giant objects and floating sticker collages. Keep landmarks grounded with the same light and small scale as the existing plants. Only illustrative background artwork.

themes.red: Theme 十步芳草: red cultural memory. Keep the bright warm coral-red earth. At edges add a compact red-flag memorial stone with a simple star symbol (no writing), a small red-roof rural reading/story pavilion, and one modest commemorative gate/steps tied to the existing village architecture. Use red and warm ivory accents; reduce generic blossoms. Do not depict a real named monument or national landmark. Place at least one recognisable memorial/reading object in each lower half side edge, rather than only at the top.
themes.culture: Theme 千年文脉: Hunan literary heritage, academies and traditional crafts. Keep warm ochre/walnut ground and the existing upper-right academy eaves. Replace edge flower pots/grass repetitions with a low ivory stone book/scroll sculpture, a small wood book cabinet/manuscript-and-brush arrangement, and a restrained traditional craft display such as a paper-cut panel (simple motif, no letters) at the margins. Existing book stack can be integrated. Small dark tiled roof and warm wood details, no huge buildings. Clear wood-brown/cream identity, no gold harvest theme.
themes.industry: Theme 金色产业: golden agricultural produce and rural production. Preserve the bright golden harvest field, sky and exact winding cream road. Add small edge clusters of tied rice sheaves with a harvest basket, a simple rural granary/storage shed, a low produce sorting table with vegetable crates, and a tiny tea-row/crop patch. These should be countryside farm facilities, not heavy factories, smokestacks or city technology. Distinct gold, warm yellow, natural brown accents. Replace generic flowers/grass repetition with these concrete agriculture elements, including in the lower half.
themes.ecology: Theme 青山绿水: mountain, stream and wetland ecology. Preserve vivid fresh green hills, sky and exact cream road. Extend a small winding stream or pond along the outer right edge into the lower half, with a small timber boardwalk/footbridge, a few wetland reeds, one modest white egret near water, and a small stone-lined spring at an opposite edge. Vary habitat elements rather than scattering more flowers. Keep structures low and simple. No huge waterwheel or park rides, no fishing or industrial elements. Soft blue water should complement the green, without crossing or changing the road.

nodes.common: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied small game level podium into a THEME-SPECIFIC variation. Match its soft polished two-dimensional illustrated UI rendering, warm rim highlights, simple edge outlines and shallow raised construction; no photorealistic/CGI look. Single isolated low standing platform viewed from the same slightly elevated frontal angle, centered, transparent background. Broad perfectly usable clear top standing area. Output composition 4:3, all edges inside frame, same overall proportions as reference. The top plane should be an ellipse or gently rounded polygon centered approximately x50%,y35%, leaving a clear flat surface for a mascot. The front rim middle must remain BLANK for an overlaid level number. No text, letters, numerals, mascot, stars floating in the air, background scenery, icons over the standing area, tall pillars, giant props or UI badge. Small motif only on the left or right edge.

themes.red: Theme red cultural heritage: a warm red sandstone OCTAGONAL commemorative plinth, ivory stone beveled foot and red-coral top. One tiny incised star on the left front corner, blank center. A low solid memorial-stone material, not a royal throne. Color matches orange-red ribbon and cream UI.
themes.culture: Theme literary heritage: a low WOODEN READING PLATFORM shaped like a shallow CLOSED BOOK with softly rounded rectangular corners. Warm walnut edge, ivory page layers and pale parchment top, tiny cloud-scroll engraving at one side, blank front middle. No upright books or large decorative props. It must remain a broad low platform to stand upon.
themes.industry: Theme golden rural agriculture: a low rounded HEXAGONAL harvest platform, golden wheat-yellow top and warm honey-gold beveled sides. One subtle wheat-ear relief near the right side; front center blank. Cream foundation. No basket, tall plants or goods above the standing plane. Bright gold distinct from brown culture.
themes.ecology: Theme green mountain and water: a smooth irregular OVAL natural gray-blue STREAM STONE base with a fresh jade-green inset top and thin turquoise water-like rim. One subtle leaf/water-ripple relief near the left edge, blank front center. Soft natural contours, broad flat standing top, low ivory-gray stone foot. No rocks protruding upward, reeds, flowers or characters.
